ABOUT MARMANSU

Connecting Japanese Healthcare Quality with Mongolia

MARMANSU is more than a distributor. We connect Japanese healthcare quality with Mongolia through products, education, medical networks, and long-term partnerships, creating sustainable healthcare solutions rather than simply supplying products.

Learn more about our story →

OUR SERVICES

What We Do

We provide end-to-end support for Japanese healthcare companies entering Mongolia and for Mongolian institutions seeking trusted medical solutions.

Pharmaceutical Distribution

Import and distribution of high-quality Japanese healthcare products.

Medical Devices & Dental

Supply of medical devices, dental materials, and related technologies.

Regulatory Support

Product registration, licensing, and market access support.

Medical Education

Seminars, workshops, clinical training, and academic exchanges.

Strategic Partnerships

Long-term partnerships between Japanese companies and Mongolian institutions.
